es.e: Lifeguards are trained to deal with emergencies.
es.c: 救生员接受过应对紧急情况的训练。

es.e: (= In case of emergency ), press the alarm button.
es.c: 遇到紧急情况，请按报警按钮。

es.e: The plane had to make an emergency landing.
es.c: 那架飞机不得不紧急着陆。

d: n 压力；重音 continuous feelings of worry about your work or personal life, that prevent you from relaxing

es.e: Your headaches are due to stress.
es.c: 你的头痛是压力造成的。

es.e: Janet’s been under a lot of stress since her mother’s illness.
es.c: 珍妮特自从母亲生病以来承受了很大的压力。

es.e: all the stresses of public life
es.c: 公众生活的所有压力

d: v 发动 to start something, usually something big or important

es.e: The organization has launched a campaign to raise $150,000.
es.c: 为了筹集15万美元，该组织发起了一场募捐活动。

es.e: The Canadian police plan to launch an investigation into the deal.
es.c: 加拿大警方计划对这宗交易进行调查。

es.e: The book launched his career as a novelist.
es.c: 这本书开启了他的小说创作生涯。

d: v 料想，以为；假定；期望 to think that something is probably true, based on what you know

es.e: There were many more deaths than was first supposed.
es.c: 死亡人数远远超过最初的预料。

es.e: There's no reason to suppose (= it is unlikely that ) he’s lying.
es.c: 没有理由认为他在说谎。

es.e: ...I suppose you're right...

d: v 消除，移除 to get rid of something so that it does not exist any longer

es.e: a cleaner that will remove wine stains
es.c: 可去除葡萄酒酒渍的清洁剂

es.e: The college removed rules that prevented women from enrolling.
es.c: 这所大学取消了禁止女性入学的规定。

es.e: ...One could remove junk food to the back of the store and ban them from the shelves at checkout lines...

d: n 暴露；揭露 when someone is in a situation where they are not protected from something dangerous or unpleasant

es.e: Exposure to lead is known to damage the brains of young children.
es.c: 已知接触铅会损害幼童的大脑。

es.e: the exposure of his underground political activity
es.c: 对他地下政治活动的揭露

es.e: ...Melanomas are more common if you have periodic intense exposure to the sun...

d: v 促进，提升；推销 If people promote something, they help or encourage it to happen, increase, or spread

es.e: You don't have to sacrifice environmental protection to promote economic growth.
es.c: 你们没有必要牺牲环保来促进经济增长。

es.e: She’s in London to promote her new book.
es.c: 例句： 她来伦敦宣传她的新书。

es.e: ...While excessive optimism can promote bad investment patterns...

d: v 从事；吸引 If you engage in an activity, you do it or are actively involved with it.

es.e: I have never engaged in drug trafficking.
es.c: 我从来没有从事过贩毒。

es.e: They never learned skills to engage the attention of the others.
es.c: 他们从来没有学过吸引别人注意的技巧。

es.e: ...Innovators engage in these mental activities regularly...

d: adj 不确定的 feeling doubt about something

es.e: My whole future now seemed uncertain.
es.c: 现在我的前途似乎是个未知数。

d: v 为…提供住宿 to provide someone with a place to stay, live, or work

es.e: The island was used to accommodate child refugees.
es.c: 该岛用于收容儿童难民。

es.e: ...and our own vision of a perfect childhood has never been adjusted to accommodate that now-common scene...

d: n 奴隶 someone who is owned by another person and works for them for no money

es.e: a slave to fashion
es.c: 时尚的奴隶

d: adj 成熟的 someone, especially a child or young person, who is mature behaves in a sensible and reasonable way, as you would expect an adult to behave

es.e: Laura is very mature for her age .
es.c: 相对她的年龄来说劳拉是很成熟的。

es.e: We’re mature enough to disagree on this issue but still respect each other.
es.c: 我们都很成熟，尽管我们对此事意见不同，但还是彼此尊重。

d: n 对照物 something that is very different from something else；v 对比 if two things contrast, the difference between them is very easy to see and is sometimes surprising

es.e: The sauce is quite sweet, so add dried thyme as a contrast.
es.c: 这调味汁很甜，所以要加点干百里香作为陪衬。

es.e: These results contrast sharply with other medical tests carried out in Australia.
es.c: 这些结果与在澳大利亚进行的其他医学测试的结果截然不同。

d: n 诊所 a place, often in a hospital, where medical treatment is given to people who do not need to stay in the hospital

es.e: an appointment at an outpatient clinic
es.c: 门诊预约

es.e: ...comes into a clinic for a check regularly...

d: v 授予；判给 to officially give someone something such as a prize or money to reward them for something they have done；n 奖(金) something such as a prize or money given to someone to reward them for something they have done

es.e: Moodie has been awarded a golf scholarship at the University of Hawaii.
es.c: 穆迪获授夏威夷大学高尔夫奖学金。

es.e: The movie has won a number of awards.
es.c: 该片获得了多个奖项。

es.e: ...Colleges taking another look at value of merit-based aid Good grades and high tests scores still matter—a lot—to many colleges as they award financial aid...

d: adj 有价值的 if something is worthwhile, it is important or useful, or you gain something from it

es.e: He wanted to do a worthwhile job.
es.c: 他想做有意义的工作。

es.e: We decided to give the money to a worthwhile cause (= one that helps people ) .
es.c: 我们决定把这笔钱投入到慈善事业中。

es.e: ...He took a 30% salary cut but felt it worthwhile for the greater intellectual opportunities...

d: n 残暴，残酷 behaviour or actions that deliberately cause pain to people or animals

es.e: The children had suffered cruelty and neglect.
es.c: 这些孩子遭受虐待，无人照管。

es.e: There was a hint of cruelty in Brian’s smile.
es.c: 布赖恩的微笑里流露出一丝残暴。

d: v 威胁 to say that you will cause someone harm or trouble if they do not do what you want

es.e: Postal workers are threatening a strike if they don’t receive a pay increase.
es.c: 邮政工人威胁如果不加薪，他们就要罢工。

d: adj 化学的 relating to substances, the study of substances, or processes involving changes in substances；n 化学制品 relating to substances, the study of substances, or processes involving changes in substances

es.e: the chemical composition of bleach
es.c: 漂白剂的化学成分

es.e: a chemical analysis of the soil
es.c: 对土壤的化学分析

es.e: synthetic chemicals
es.c: 合成化学品

d: adj 一致的 always behaving in the same way or having the same attitudes, standards etc – usually used to show approval

es.e: We need to be consistent in our approach.
es.c: 我们在方法上要前后一致。

es.e: ...is less about career-building relationships than a consistent search for new ideas...
...Jobs' career can be viewed as a consistent pursuit of improving those odds...

d: v 〔中止后〕重新开始，继续 to begin doing something again after a period of not doing it

es.e: Local people have renewed their efforts to save the school.
es.c: 当地居民再一次作出努力，挽救这所学校。

es.e: Police renewed their appeal for witnesses.
es.c: 警察再次呼吁目击者出来作证。

es.e: ...making up for the third of their members who do not renew each year...

d: n 起飞 Takeoff is the beginning of a flight, when an aircraft leaves the ground

es.e: What time is takeoff?
es.c: 起飞时间是什么时候？

d: adj 无辜的；天真的 not guilty of a crime

es.e: Nobody would believe that I was innocent.
es.c: 没人肯相信我是清白的。

es.e: The court found him innocent and he was released.
es.c: 法庭判他无罪，他被释放了。

es.e: I was thirteen years old and very innocent.
es.c: 我那时13岁，非常单纯无知。

d: adv 当前；一般地 at the present time

es.e: the products that are currently available
es.c: 目前供应的产品

es.e: He is currently working on his first novel.
es.c: 他目前正在创作他的第一本小说。

es.e: ...I am currently owning a used bicycle for sale...

d: n 辍学者 someone who leaves school or college before they have finished

es.e: a high school dropout
es.c: 中学退学者

es.e: ...and high dropout rates...
...and now have the highest college dropout rate in the world...

d: v 代替 to start doing something instead of another person, or start being used instead of another thing

es.e: I’m replacing Sue on the team.
es.c: 我将接替队里的休。

es.e: Lectures have replaced the old tutorial system.
es.c: 课堂授课取代了旧式的导师制。

es.e: ...they totally cannot replace going to school...

d: n 观光 when you visit famous or interesting places, especially as tourists

es.e: She swam and sunbathed, went sightseeing and relaxed.
es.c: 她游泳，晒日光浴，观光，放松。

d: n 荣誉；崇敬，敬重，敬意 the respect that you, your family, your country etc receive from other people, which makes you feel proud

es.e: For the French team, winning tomorrow’s game is a matter of national honor.
es.c: 对法国队来说，打赢明天的比赛事关国家荣誉。

es.e: ...It is really an honor for me to be your sister and I will cherish the goodwill you showed to me wherever I go...
...It is really an honor for me to be your friend and I will cherish the goodwill you have showed to me wherever I go...

d: v 模仿 to copy the way someone behaves, speaks, moves etc, especially in order to make people laugh

es.e: She was a splendid mimic and loved to imitate Winston Churchill.
es.c: 她是个出色的模仿者，喜欢模仿温斯顿·丘吉尔。

es.e: ...as cities across the country imitate the walkability and transit-oriented development making cities like New York and San Francisco so successful...
...But by doing his best to imitate Mr Jobs...

d: n 分期付款 one of a series of regular payments that you make until you have paid all the money you owe
n 个性，性格 someone’s character, especially the way they behave towards other people

es.e: Despite their different personalities, they became the best of friends.
es.c: 尽管个性不同，他们还是成了最好的朋友。

es.e: Unfortunately, the illness can lead to changes in personality.
es.c: 不幸的是，这种病会导致性格变化。

es.e: ...And they're talking about the British personality – the famous British reserve...

d: v 设立总部，在…设立总部 to place in or establish as headquarters

es.e: The new company will headquarter in Paris.
es.c: 新公司会将总部设在巴黎。

d: n 成分，原料 one of the foods that you use to make a particular food or dish

es.e: Combine all the ingredients in a large bowl.
es.c: 把所有食材都放在一个大碗里。

es.e: The food is home-cooked using fresh ingredients.
es.c: 这种食物是用新鲜的食材在家里烹制的。

es.e: ...is the crucial ingredient in all economic progress--higher growth for nations...

d: n 收入 money that a business or organization receives over a period of time, especially from selling goods or services

es.e: advertising revenue
es.c: 广告收入

es.e: Strikes have cost £20 million in lost revenues .
es.c: 罢工造成的收入损失达到2,000万英镑。

es.e: ...We are losing revenue as we speak...

d: adj 敏感的 easily upset or offended by events or things that people say

es.e: a very sensitive child
es.c: 一个很敏感的小孩

es.e: ...I’m extremely sensitive to sounds...
...They are sensitive to the dynamics in the negotiation...

d: adj 特别的，特指的；讲究的；挑剔的，吹毛求疵的 a particular thing or person is the one that you are talking about, and not any other

es.e: In this particular case, no one else was involved.
es.c: 这件事没有其他人牵涉其中。

es.e: Most students choose one particular area for research.
es.c: 大多数学生选择一个特定领域进行研究。

es.e: Marty’s very particular about his food.
es.c: 马蒂对食物很挑剔。

d: n 瘤 a mass of diseased cells in your body that have divided and increased too quickly

es.e: The tumor will soon be resolved.
es.c: 这个肿瘤很快就会消掉的。

es.e: He literally pulled those cells out of their blood and grew billions more of them in laboratory dishes, enough to have a chance at overwhelming a tumor.
es.c: 他精确地把那些细胞从他们的血液中抽离出来，在实验室的培养皿中让其增值数十亿倍，大到足以有可能制服一个肿瘤。

d: n 结果，成果 something that happens as a result of a particular action or set of conditions

es.e: Her lawyer said she understood the consequences of her actions and was prepared to go to jail.
es.c: 她的律师说她明白自己行为的后果并准备去坐牢。

es.e: ...What people were like when they came in had greater consequence than what happened one they were there...
...Partly as a consequence of this limited time...

d: adv 直接地，明确地

es.e: You have to grant us control explicitly.
es.c: 你们必须允许我们明确地控制。

es.e: Tell them explicitly you want to continue the friendship.
es.c: 明确地告诉他们你想继续这段友谊。

es.e: Therefore, you need to include these in your source files explicitly.
es.c: 因此，您需要将这些都明确地包含进源文件中。

d: v 影响 to influence someone so that they change their opinion

es.e: Don’t allow yourself to be swayed by his promises.
es.c: 你可不要听了他的许诺就改变主意呀。

es.e: ...the new generation can find it more difficult to advance--an argument that typically holds little sway to a nevertiree...

d: adj 技术的 connected with knowledge of how machines work

es.e: Our staff will be available to give you technical support .
es.c: 有我们的员工向你提供技术支持。

es.e: I have no technical knowledge at all.
es.c: 我一点技术知识都没有。

es.e: technical training
es.c: 技术培训

d: adj 熟练的，内行的 having a special skill or special knowledge of a subject

es.e: He cast his expert eye on the gardener’s work.
es.c: 他用内行的眼光看了看园丁干的活。

es.e: ...snake expert Robert Henderson from the Museum of Natural History...
...I momentarily wondered if I couldn't just call an expert on the subject matter which I was tackling...

d: n 损害；危害；伤害 damage, injury, or trouble caused by someone’s actions or by an event；v 伤害，损害〔某事物〕 to have a bad effect on something

es.e: The scandal did his career a lot of harm.
es.c: 丑闻对他的职业生涯造成很大损害。

es.e: chemicals that harm the environment
es.c: 损害环境的化学品

es.e: ...It generally does more harm than good...

d: adj 虚构的，想象的 not real, but produced from pictures or ideas in your mind

es.e: As she listened, she played an imaginary piano on her knees.
es.c: 她边听边在膝盖上作弹钢琴状。

es.e: We must protect older people from harm, whether it is real or imaginary.
es.c: 我们必须保护老人免受伤害，无论这伤害是真实的还是假想的。

d: v 污染，弄脏 to make a place or substance dirty or harmful by putting something such as chemicals or poison in it

es.e: Drinking water supplies are believed to have been contaminated.
es.c: 据信饮用水已受到污染。

d: v 猛增 to increase quickly to a high level

es.e: Her temperature soared.
es.c: 她的体温骤然升高。

es.e: The price of petrol has soared in recent weeks.
es.c: 最近几个星期汽油价格猛涨。

es.e: soaring unemployment
es.c: 急剧上升的失业率

d: adv 单独地，唯一地 not involving anything or anyone else

es.e: Scholarships are given solely on the basis of financial need.
es.c: 奖学金完全是根据经济需要发放的。

es.e: I shall hold you solely responsible for anything that goes wrong.
es.c: 出现任何差错的话，我唯你是问。

es.e: ...Hunger isn't controlled solely by the physical characteristics of a recent meal...

d: adj 巨大的 very big, fast, powerful etc

es.e: Suddenly, there was a tremendous bang, and the whole station shook.
es.c: 突然一声巨响，整个车站都晃动了。

es.e: She was making a tremendous effort to appear calm.
es.c: 她竭力表现出平静的样子。

es.e: She praised her husband for the tremendous support he had given her.
es.c: 她称赞丈夫给了她巨大支持。

d: n 文明 a society that is well organized and developed, used especially about a particular society in a particular place or at a particular time

es.e: modern American civilization
es.c: 现代美国文明

d: adj 困难的 difficult to do or deal with

es.e: It was a tough race.
es.c: 比赛打得很艰难。

es.e: She’s had a tough life.
es.c: 她的生活十分艰辛。

es.e: The company admitted that it had been a tough year.
es.c: 公司承认那是艰难的一年。

d: n 礼物；天赋 something that you give someone, for example to thank them or because you like them, especially on a special occasion

es.e: The earrings were a gift from my aunt.
es.c: 这副耳环是我姑姑送给我的礼物。

es.e: The clock was given as a retirement gift when he left the police.
es.c: 这个钟表是他退休离开警局时收到的礼物。

es.e: expensive wedding gifts
es.c: 昂贵的结婚礼物

d: n 规模；比例 the size or level of something, or the amount that something is happening

es.e: A structural survey revealed the full scale of the damage.
es.c: 结构检验揭示了实际受损程度。

es.e: I was shocked by the sheer scale (= very big scale ) of the destruction.
es.c: 破坏程度之大让我大为震惊。

es.e: Large firms benefit from economies of scale (= ways of saving money because they are big ) .
es.c: 大公司从规模经济中得益。

d: v 使受伤 to hurt yourself or someone else, for example in an accident or an attack

es.e: Angus injured his leg playing rugby.
es.c: 安格斯在打橄榄球时弄伤了腿。

d: v 拥抱；欣然接受，乐意采纳 (新思想、意见、宗教等) to put your arms around someone and hold them in a friendly or loving way

es.e: Jack warmly embraced his son.
es.c: 杰克热情拥抱他的儿子。

es.e: Most West European countries have embraced the concept of high-speed rail networks with enthusiasm.
es.c: 大多数西欧国家都表现出极大的兴趣，欣然接受修建高速铁路网的想法。

es.e: ...today's young women have been pushed to embrace both perfection and passion to pursue science and sports...

d: adv 很少，罕见 very rarely or almost never

es.e: Karen had seldom seen him so angry.
es.c: 卡伦很少见他这么生气过。

es.e: ...British people seldom speak on the train...
...I seldom had time to enjoy my hobby...

d: n 演出；履行；表现 when someone performs a play or a piece of music

es.e: This evening’s performance will begin at 8.00 pm.
es.c: 今晚的演出8点开始。

es.e: the performance of his official duties
es.c: 履行他的职务

es.e: Sean’s performance at school has greatly improved.
es.c: 肖恩在学校的表现进步很大。

d: v 违反 to disobey or do something against an official agreement, law, principle etc

es.e: 34 protesters were arrested for violating criminal law.
es.c: 34名抗议者因违反刑法而被逮捕。

es.e: regimes that violate human rights
es.c: 侵犯人权的政权

es.e: ...What would happen to big restaurant chains that violate the new rule...

d: v 把……联系起来；交往； to make a connection in your mind between one thing or person and another

es.e: Through science we've got the idea of associating progress with the future.
es.c: 通过科学我们已有了将进步与未来联系起来的观念。

es.e: I don’t like these layabouts you’re associating with.
es.c: 文例句：我不喜欢你结交的这些游手好闲的人。

es.e: ...an associate professor of medicine at the university...

d: n 隐私 the state of being free from public attention

es.e: each individual’s right to privacy
es.c: 每个人的隐私权

es.e: ...when the privacy of grief is more respected...
...Nowadays people respect the privacy of grief more than in the past...

d: v 使窒息 to be unable to breathe properly because something is in your throat or there is not enough air

es.e: Six people choked to death on the fumes.
es.c: 六人被烟呛死。

es.e: ...which is why we choke up when we weep...

d: adj 能干的，有能力的 having the qualities or ability needed to do something

es.e: I don’t think he’s capable of murder.
es.c: 我认为他没有能力杀人。

es.e: The company isn’t capable of handling an order that large.
es.c: 那家公司没有能力应付那么大的订单。

es.e: I’m perfectly capable of looking after myself, thank you!
es.c: 我完全能够自己照顾自己，多谢了！

d: n 呼吁 an urgent request for something important；v 吸引；呼吁；恳请，恳求 if someone or something appeals to you, they seem attractive and interesting

es.e: The girl’s family have made a public appeal for help to try and catch her killer.
es.c: 那名遇害女孩的家人吁请公众协助捉拿凶手。

es.e: The programme appeals to young children.
es.c: 这个节目受小孩子喜欢。

es.e: Church and community leaders have appealed for calm.
es.c: 教会和社区领袖都呼吁保持冷静。

d: adj 粗心的 not paying enough attention to what you are doing, so that you make mistakes, damage things etc

es.e: It was careless of him to leave the door unlocked.
es.c: 他忘了锁门，真是粗心大意。

es.e: a careless mistake
es.c: 粗心造成的错误

es.e: careless driving
es.c: 粗心驾驶

d: n (唱片、电影或戏剧的) 成功；命中，击中 something such as a film, play, song etc that is very popular and successful

es.e: Which band had a hit with ‘Bohemian Rhapsody’?
es.c: 《波希米亚狂想曲》是哪支乐队风行一时的歌曲？

es.e: Our ship took a direct hit and sank
es.c: 例句：我们的船被直接击中下沉了。

es.e: ...have been hit particularly hard in this downturn because they are competing with the global giant McDonald's...

d: v 咽下，吞下 to make food or drink go down your throat and towards your stomach

es.e: He swallowed the last of his coffee and asked for the bill.
es.c: 他喝完最后一口咖啡，要求结账。

es.e: Most snakes swallow their prey whole .
es.c: 大多数蛇都是把猎物囫囵吞下。

es.e: ...I remember my aunt Mary used to say if you swallow a cherrystone...

d: v 咨询 to ask for information or advice from someone because it is their job to know something

es.e: If symptoms persist, consult a doctor without delay.
es.c: 如果症状持续的话，马上咨询医生。

d: n 保存，保留 when something is kept in its original state or in good condition

es.e: methods of food preservation
es.c: 保存食物的各种方法

d: n 距离 the amount of space between two places or things

d: adj 尴尬的；窘迫的 feeling uncomfortable or nervous and worrying about what people think of you, for example because you have made a silly mistake, or because you have to talk or sing in public

es.e: Lori gets embarrassed if we ask her to sing.
es.c: 我们要是请洛丽唱歌，她就会难为情。

es.e: He looked embarrassed when I asked him where he’d been.
es.c: 我问他去了哪里，他显得很窘迫。

es.e: ...It's no longer the case that the common man in England is embarrassed to show he knows about food...

d: adj 神智清楚的 A rational person is someone who is sensible and is able to make decisions based on intelligent thinking rather than on emotion

es.e: Did he come across as a sane, rational person?
es.c: 他看上去是不是一个头脑清醒而理智的人？

es.e: ...They are always polite and rational people...
...The author thinks her friend made a rational decision in choosing a more hospitable place over an apparently elegant assisted living home...

d: adj 遥远的 far away in space or time

es.e: the sound of distant gunfire
es.c: 远处的炮火声

es.e: Her honeymoon seemed a distant memory .
es.c: 她的蜜月似乎成了遥远的记忆。

es.e: That affair was in the dim and distant past (= a long time ago ) .
es.c: 那件事已成为遥远的过去了。

d: n 主妇 a woman who works at home cleaning and cooking etc and does not have another job

es.e: Whether you are a carpenter or a therapist, a homemaker or a professor, it makes no difference.
es.c: 不论你是一个木匠或是一个治疗师，一个家庭主妇还是教授，这都没有区别。

es.e: My mother was a mother, homemaker.… I think my mother influenced me as far as my love for reading.
es.c: 我母亲就是一位母亲，家庭主妇……我想我母亲对我的影响很大，甚至包括我对阅读的喜爱。

es.e: “I would not have wanted to live in my parents’ or grandparents’ time,” said Mrs. Peeples, a full-time homemaker.
es.c: 皮尔普斯太太现在是个全职主妇。 她说：“我不会继续活在我父母或祖父母那个时代了。

d: n 例外 something or someone that is not included in a general statement or does not follow a rule or pattern

es.e: It’s been cold, but today’s an exception.
es.c: 天气一直寒冷，但今天是个例外。

es.e: The law applies to all EU countries; Britain is no exception.
es.c: 这项法律适用于所有欧盟国家，英国也不例外。

es.e: We don’t usually accept checks, but for you we’ll make an exception (= not include you in this rule ).
es.c: 我们一般不接受支票，但对你我们就破个例。

d: adj 可持续的 able to continue without causing damage to the environment

es.e: The government should do more to promote sustainable agriculture.
es.c: 政府应该做更多工作来推动可持续农业的发展。

es.e: the sustainable use of rainforest resources
es.c: 雨林资源的可持续利用

es.e: Cycling is a totally sustainable form of transport.
es.c: 骑自行车是一种绝对环保的交通方式。

d: v 引发，引起 to make something happen very quickly, especially a series of events

es.e: The assassination triggered off a wave of rioting.
es.c: 这次暗杀事件引发了一阵骚乱。

es.e: Certain forms of mental illness can be triggered by food allergies.
es.c: 某些精神疾病可能由食物过敏引发。

es.e: His action triggered a massive response from the government.
es.c: 他的行动引发了政府的巨大反应。

d: v 打算 If you intend to do something, you have decided or planned to do it.

es.e: Oddly enough, that is precisely what I intend.
es.c: 说也奇怪， 那正是我的打算。

es.e: They intend to be an army of light against the onslaught of darkness.
es.c: 他们打算成为一支光明之师对抗黑暗军团的猛烈进攻。

es.e: ...Anyone interested or intend to inquire about please do not feel hesitated to contact Xiao Li...

d: v 扩散；传播 if something spreads or is spread, it becomes larger or moves so that it affects more people or a larger area

es.e: The cancer had spread to her liver.
es.c: 癌已经扩散到她的肝脏。

es.e: The news spread like wildfire.
es.c: 消息如野火般迅速传开。

es.e: ...The project is a growing one and has spread from the park to the school and the shopping center...

d: v 估计 to try to judge the value, size, speed, cost etc of something, without calculating it exactly

es.e: Try to estimate how many steps it will take to get to a close object.
es.c: 估计一下需要多少步才能到达一个近距目标。

es.e: ...I recently tried to estimate this impact in terms of a most famous food...
...Surveys estimate that 85% of women and 73% of men report feeling better after shedding tears...

d: n 技巧，手艺；技术，技能 a special way of doing something

es.e: In mathematics, we use many techniques of problem-solving.
es.c: 在数学中，我们会使用多种方法解题。

es.e: He’s a great player, with brilliant technique.
es.c: 他是个伟大的球员，球技十分精湛。

es.e: ...she became interested in eggs and learned the traditional Ukrainian technique to draw her very modem characters...

d: v 包含 if one thing includes another, the second thing is part of the first

es.e: Does the price include postage?
es.c: 这个价格包含邮费吗？

es.e: His job includes looking after under-21 teams.
es.c: 他的职责包括照管21岁以下球队。

es.e: The curriculum includes courses in computing.
es.c: 课程内容包括计算机技术。

d: adj 学术的 relating to education, especially at college or university level

es.e: He possessed no academic qualifications.
es.c: 他没有学历。

es.e: a program to raise academic standards
es.c: 旨在提高学术水平的计划

es.e: ...Leslie criticizes the received wisdom that academic success is the result of a combination of intellectual talent and hard work...

d: adj 独特的，与众不同的 having a special quality, character, or appearance that is different and easy to recognize

es.e: a rock band with a distinctive sound
es.c: 音色独特的摇滚乐队

d: v 由……组成 to be formed from two or more things or people

es.e: My diet consisted almost exclusively of chocolate-covered cookies and glasses of milk.
es.c: 我的饮食几乎只包含裹上巧克力的曲奇饼和一杯杯牛奶。

d: n 出价，投标 an offer to pay a particular price for something, especially at an  auction；v 出价，投标 to offer to pay a particular price for goods, especially in an auction

es.e: the person who places the highest bid
es.c: 出价最高的人

es.e: We’ve made a bid of nearly £400 million for the company.
es.c: 我们出价近四亿英镑收购那家公司。

es.e: A takeover bid for the airline was launched today.
es.c: 今天有人出价收购该航空公司。

d: v 有益于，有助于 if you benefit from something, or it benefits you, it gives you an advantage, improves your life, or helps you in some way

es.e: They are working together to benefit the whole community.
es.c: 他们在为整个社区的利益共同努力。

es.e: ...This behavior may have evolved as dogs gradually learned they could benefit from avoiding conflicts with humans...
...The puzzle was what benefit would be gained from it when performance might be affected the following day...

d: v 裁员 if a company or organization downsizes, it reduces the number of people it employs in order to reduce costs

es.e: The airline has downsized its workforce by 30%.
es.c: 这家航空公司裁员30%。

d: v 避免 to prevent something bad from happening

es.e: Road safety is taught to young children to avoid road accidents.
es.c: 小孩子受到道路安全知识的教育，以避免交通事故。

es.e: It is important to take measures to avoid the risk of fire.
es.c: 采取措施避免火灾风险很重要。

es.e: Alan narrowly avoided an accident.
es.c: 艾伦险出事故。

d: n 性别 the fact of being male or female

es.e: people of the same gender
es.c: 同性别的人

es.e: Discrimination on grounds of race or gender is forbidden.
es.c: 严禁种族歧视和性别歧视。

es.e: There may be gender differences in attitudes to paid work.
es.c: 对待有偿劳动的态度可能存在着性别差异。

d: adj 种族间的 between different races of people

es.e: interracial marriage
es.c: 种族间的通婚

es.e: ...Researchers also observed problems resulting from pairing interracial students in residences...
...An Indiana University study found that interracial roommates were three times as likely as two white roommates to no longer live together by the end of the semester...

d: n 抱怨; 投诉 a statement in which someone complains about something

es.e: If you wish to make a complaint, you should see the manager.
es.c: 如果你要投诉，应该去找经理。

es.e: The sales assistants are trained to deal with customer complaints in a friendly manner.
es.c: 售货员都受过培训，要以友好的态度处理顾客的投诉。

es.e: ...What should you do if you make a complaint by letter...

d: n 模式 the regular way in which something happens, develops, or is done

es.e: Weather patterns have changed in recent years.
es.c: 气候模式近年已经发生了变化。

es.e: A general pattern began to emerge .
es.c: 一个总体模式开始显现。

es.e: Their descriptions seemed to follow a set pattern (= always develop in the same way ) .
es.c: 他们的描述似乎依据固定的模式。

d: n 心情 the way you feel at a particular time

es.e: You’re in a good mood this morning!
es.c: 你今天早晨心情不错啊！

es.e: the general mood of depression in the office
es.c: 办公室里普遍的沮丧情绪

es.e: ...better mood and alertness...

d: n 同情心 the feeling of being sorry for someone who is in a bad situation

es.e: Our sympathies are with the families of the victims.
es.c: 我们向受害者家庭表示慰问。

es.e: ...Our ability to experience sympathy is essential to the development of civilization...

d: n 折扣 a reduction in the usual price of something

es.e: They are often available at a discount.
es.c: 它们经常可以以折扣价买到。

es.e: ...you might be able to get a discount if you fly economy class...
...Apple's fortunes suffered from an innovation discount during Jobs' absence...

d: v 重视 to think that someone or something is important

es.e: Shelley valued her privacy.
es.c: 谢利很重视自己的隐私。

es.e: ...This has wiped 6% off the value of the soft tissue paper market in the UK...
...or is here something of particular value about curiosity in and of itself...

d: n 海拔, 高度 the height of an object or place above the sea

es.e: The aircraft had reached its cruising altitude of about 39,000 feet.
es.c: 那架飞机已经达到了大约三万九千英尺的巡航高度。

es.e: ...Australian scientist David Warren developed a flight-memory recorder that would track basic information like altitude and direction...

d: n 防潮布 a piece of material that water cannot pass through which people sleep on when they are camping

es.e: One more thing, remind me to get some kind of groundsheet or we'll end up getting filthy.
es.c: 还有一件事，记得提醒我带一些防潮布之类的东西，否则我们结束的时候会一片狼籍。

d: adj 进化的；演变的 relating to the way in which plants and animals develop and change gradually over a long period of time

es.e: the evolutionary development of birds
es.c: 鸟类的进化过程

es.e: Some scientists have rejected evolutionary theory.
es.c: 有些科学家拒绝接受进化论。

es.e: He is in favour of gradual, evolutionary social change.
es.c: 他支持渐进的社会变革。

d: v 实施，执行 to take action or make changes that you have officially decided should happen

es.e: The government promised to implement a new system to control financial loan institutions.
es.c: 政府许诺要实施新的制度来控制金融贷款机构。

d: adj 占优势的 more powerful, important, or noticeable than other people or things

es.e: The dominant male gorilla is the largest in the group.
es.c: 领头的公猩猩是这群大猩猩中体形最大的一个。

es.e: Japan became dominant in the mass market during the 1980s.
es.c: 20世纪80年代日本在大众市场上开始占据优势。

es.e: its dominant position within the group
es.c: 它在该组织中的突出地位

d: n 范围 the range of things that a subject, activity, book etc deals with

es.e: measures to limit the scope of criminals’ activities
es.c: 限制罪犯活动范围的措施

es.e: ...We’d better take advantage of good online recreational activities to enrich our lives and broaden the scope of knowledge...

d: v 怀疑，猜想 to think that something is probably true, especially something bad；n 嫌疑犯 someone who is thought to be guilty of a crime

es.e: She strongly suspected he was lying to her.
es.c: 她非常怀疑他在对她撒谎。

es.e: She’s not going to be very happy about this, I suspect .
es.c: 我想对于此事她不会太高兴。

es.e: ...The next step is for the suspect to go before a judge...

d: n 冲突，对抗 a situation in which there is a lot of angry disagreement between two people or groups

es.e: She had stayed in her room to avoid another confrontation.
es.c: 她待在自己的房间里，以避免再次发生冲突。

es.e: ...but as the saying goes: From confrontation comes brilliance...
...and avoided confrontation between those eyeing the same parking space...

d: v 迷惑 If something puzzles you, you do not understand it and feel confused；n 难解之事，谜 something that is difficult to understand or explain

es.e: My sister puzzles me and causes me anxiety.
es.c: 我的妹妹常会让我不解，使我焦虑。

es.e: He thought he had solved the puzzle .
es.c: 他认为他已经解开了那个谜。

es.e: ...The puzzle was what benefit would be gained from it when performance might be affected the following day...

d: n 批评家，评论家 someone whose job is to make judgments about the good and bad qualities of art, music, films etc

es.e: Mather was a film critic for many years.
es.c: 马瑟做过多年的电影评论家。

es.e: ...each critic in those curious...
...There are two ways to interpret Plutarch when he suggests that a critic should be able to produce a better in its place...

d: n 公寓 a set of rooms on one floor of a large building, where someone lives

es.e: She lives in a small apartment.
es.c: 她住在一套小公寓里。

es.e: ...An Airbnb user had her apartment trashed in 2011...
...but I promise Laura we'd clean the apartment this weekend...

d: v 分析 to examine or think about something carefully, in order to understand it

es.e: How do you analyze this change?
es.c: 你该如何分析这种变化？

es.e: You have to hoover anything before you can analyze it.
es.c: 在你不具备分析能力之前，你只得胡乱吸收你所能学到的东西。

es.e: We should learn to discern and analyze the essentials of complicated questions.
es.c: 我们应该学会认识和分析复杂问题的本质。

d: v 维持；主张 to make something continue in the same way or at the same standard as before

es.e: Careers Officers maintain contact with young people when they have left school.
es.c: 年轻人离开学校以后，职业指导员和他们保持联系。

es.e: Britain wants to maintain its position as a world power.
es.c: 英国想保持其世界强国的地位。

es.e: A lot depends on building and maintaining a good relationship with your customers.
es.c: 和顾客建立并保持良好关系很重要，很多事情要取决于此。

d: v 控制 to control or limit something in order to prevent it from having a harmful effect；n 控制 an influence which helps to control or limit something

es.e: measures to curb the spread of the virus
es.c: 控制病毒扩散的措施

es.e: We are trying to keep a curb on their activities.
es.c: 我们正设法控制他们的活动。

es.e: ...hoping to curb medical error...

d: n 版本 a copy of something that has been changed so that it is slightly different

es.e: the human version of mad cow disease
es.c: 疯牛病的人类变体

es.e: ...The company just released an updated version last week...

d: n 对手 a person, group, or organization that you compete with in sport, business, a fight etc

es.e: This gives the company a competitive advantage over its rivals.
es.c: 这使该公司与其对手相比具有一项竞争优势。

es.e: He finished 39 seconds ahead of his main rival .
es.c: 他比主要对手早39秒到达终点。

es.e: She was 2 minutes faster than her nearest rival .
es.c: 她比紧随其后的对手快两分钟。

d: adj 有利的，有益的 having a good effect

es.e: a drug that has a beneficial effect on the immune system
es.c: 有益于免疫系统的一种药物

es.e: an arrangement that is mutually beneficial
es.c: 一项互惠互利的协定

es.e: ...which is beneficial for them to improve their relationship...

d: adj 大量的 large in amount or number

es.e: We have the support of a substantial number of parents.
es.c: 我们有相当多家长的支持。

es.e: a substantial salary
es.c: 丰厚的薪水

es.e: a substantial breakfast
es.c: 丰盛的早餐

d: v 恢复；重新获得；寻回 to get better after an illness, accident, shock etc

es.e: After a few days of fever, she began to recover.
es.c: 发烧几天之后，她开始恢复。

es.e: Two bodies were recovered from the wreckage.
es.c: 残骸中找到了两具尸体

es.e: ...There 're many people who recover from cancer...

d: n 文凭 a document showing that a student has successfully completed their  high school  or university education

es.e: ...a new two-year course leading to a diploma in social work.
es.c: ...一门可以获得社会工作文凭的2年制的新课程。

es.e: ...the extra time and money spent pursuing a college diploma will leave them worse off than they were before they set foot on campus...
...These graduates were told that a diploma was all they needed to succeed...

d: n 木匠 someone whose job is making and repairing wooden objects

es.e: He is a carpenter by profession.
es.c: 他以木工为业。

es.e: At an early age, I was apprenticed to a carpenter.
es.c: 我小时候曾给木匠当过学徒。

es.e: That carpenter wanted to become a lawyer， but he was advised to stick to his last.
es.c: 那个木匠想当律师， 但别人劝他安分守己地干他自己的老本行。

d: n 环境，境遇 the combination of facts, events etc that influence your life, and that you cannot control

es.e: He was a victim of circumstance .
es.c: 他是客观环境的牺牲品。

d: n 食堂 a place in a factory, school etc where meals are provided, usually quite cheaply

es.e: Rennie had eaten his supper in the canteen.
es.c: 伦尼已在食堂吃过晚饭。

es.e: ...I’ve had enough of our canteen food.Q: What do we learn about the woman...

d: n 主张者，倡导者
adj 杂乱的 untidy or without any order

es.e: clothes left in a disorderly heap
es.c: 乱七八糟堆在一起的衣服

d: adv 本质上，根本上 used when stating the most basic facts about something

es.e: Ballet is essentially a middle-class interest.
es.c: 芭蕾舞基本上是中产阶级感兴趣的东西。

es.e: Suicide rates have remained essentially unchanged.
es.c: 自杀率基本上保持不变。

es.e: Essentially, we are talking about the cold war period.
es.c: 我们基本上是在谈论冷战时期。

d: v 预防 to stop something from happening, or stop someone from doing something

es.e: The rules are intended to prevent accidents.
es.c: 这些规定旨在预防事故。

es.e: We were prevented from entering the site.
es.c: 我们被阻止进入现场。

es.e: Wrap small ornaments in paper to prevent them being damaged.
es.c: 把小饰品用纸包上以免损坏。

d: n 典礼，仪式 an important social or religious event, when a traditional set of actions is performed in a formal way

es.e: a wedding ceremony
es.c: 婚礼

es.e: the opening ceremony of the Olympic Games
es.c: 奥运会开幕式

es.e: ...remembers sitting with other teachers watching students file out of a graduation ceremony and asking one another in astonishment...

d: v 假定，认为 to think that something is true, although you do not have definite proof

es.e: I think we can safely assume (=  it is almost certain  ) that interest rates will go up again soon.
es.c: 我想我们几乎可以肯定，利率很快会再次上调。

es.e: When it got to midnight and Paul was still not back, I began to assume the worst (=  think that the worst possible thing had happened  ) .
es.c: 到午夜时保罗还没回来，我就开始往最坏的地方想了。

es.e: ...The article says many people tend to assume that innovation just means creating something new...

d: n 需求，要求 the need or desire that people have for particular goods and services；v 要求 to ask for something very firmly, especially because you think you have a right to do this

es.e: Production is still increasing faster than demand.
es.c: 生产仍比需求增长快。

es.e: Angry demonstrators demanded the resignation of two senior officials.
es.c: 愤怒的示威者要求两名高级官员辞职。

es.e: ...They prefer something unique and they demand quality...

d: n 原则，原理 a moral rule or belief about what is right and wrong, that influences how you behave

es.e: Schools try to teach children a set of principles.
es.c: 学校设法教给孩子们一套道德准则。

es.e: He’s got no principles at all!
es.c: 他毫无道德准则！

es.e: It’s against my principles to accept gifts from clients.
es.c: 收受客户礼物违背我的原则。

d: n 接待；反响 a particular type of welcome for someone, or a particular type of reaction to their ideas, work etc

es.e: She was unsure of her reception after everything that had happened.
es.c: 发生了这些事后，她对自己是否还受欢迎没把握。

es.e: The plans received a mixed reception from unions (= some people liked them, others did not ) .
es.c: 各工会对这些计划反响不一。

es.e: ...You go pay the bill andI'll call the reception to have our luggage taken downstairs...

d: v 转换，调换 to move from one place, school, job etc to another, or to make someone do this, especially within the same organization；n 转换，调换 the process by which someone or something moves or is moved from one place, job etc

es.e: You’ll be transferred to the Birmingham office.
es.c: 在你将被调到伯明翰办事处。

es.e: Penny’s applied for a transfer to head office.
es.c: 彭妮已申请调到总部去。

es.e: ...I've heard that at a factory in the area two pregnant women who were working with paint requested a transfer to a safer department...

d: adj 可预防的 Preventable diseases, illnesses, or deaths could be stopped from occurring

es.e: Forty thousand children a day die from preventable diseases.
es.c: 每天有四万儿童死于本可以防止的疾病。

es.e: ...He added that he had warned Mclaughlin that three preventable accidents in one year could lead to his discharge...

d: v 预感 to expect that something will happen and be ready for it

es.e: Sales are better than anticipated.
es.c: 销量比预期要好。

es.e: A good speaker is able to anticipate an audience’s needs and concerns.
es.c: 好的演讲者能够预先考虑到听众需要什么、关注什么。

d: n 假定，假设 something that you think is true although you have no definite proof

es.e: You would be making an assumption that's not based on any fact that you could report.
es.c: 你会做出不以你能报道的任何事实为依据的一种假设。

d: n 处方 a piece of paper on which a doctor writes what medicine a sick person should have, so that they can get it from a  pharmacist

es.e: We are trying to cut the price of prescription drugs .

es.c: 我们把包扔在附近的格兰德旅馆，急匆匆地向市场赶去。

es.e: a campaign to stop cheap European beef being dumped in West Africa
es.c: 阻止在西非倾销廉价欧洲牛肉的运动

es.e: ...Landfills are places to dump waste...

d: v 抵抗，抗拒 to try to prevent a change from happening, or prevent yourself from being forced to do something

es.e: He resisted pressure to resign.
es.c: 他顶住压力，没辞职。

es.e: ...so long as Barack Obama and the Democrats in Congress resist the temptation to interfere too much...

d: n 来源 a thing, place, activity etc that you get something from

es.e: They get their money from various sources.
es.c: 他们从各种途径弄到钱。

es.e: ...bringing a welcome source of protein at winter’s end...
...The Great London Fire of 1666 burned many important documents that could have been a source of clues...

d: adj 法律的 if something is legal, you are allowed to do it or have to do it by law

es.e: What the company has done is perfectly legal.
es.c: 公司所做的这一切完全合法。

es.e: plans to make the carrying of identity cards a legal requirement
es.c: 使携带身份证成为法定要求的计划

es.e: He had twice the legal limit of alcohol in his bloodstream.
es.c: 他血液中的酒精含量是法定限度的两倍。

d: adj 挑剔的 someone who is picky only likes particular things and not others, and so is not easy to please

es.e: He’s a very picky eater .
es.c: 他很挑食。

d: v 偷窃 to take something that belongs to someone else

es.e: Boys broke into a shop and stole £45 in cash.
es.c: 男孩们闯进一家商店，盗走了45英镑现金。

d: prep 尽管 used to say that something happens or is true even though something else might have prevented it

es.e: Despite all our efforts to save the school, the authorities decided to close it.
es.c: 尽管我们竭力想保住这所学校，当局还是决定把它关闭。

es.e: ...despite its potential to work wonders...
...despite an increase in the UK population and a subsequent rise in the number of households...

d: n 爆炸 a loud sound and the energy produced by something such as a bomb bursting into small pieces

es.e: We heard a loud explosion.
es.c: 我们听到一声巨大的爆炸声。

es.e: ...A recent study suggests that doctors start to make more objective decisions about who will truly benefit from screening- especially considering the explosion of the elderly that will soon swell our population...

d: n 缝隙，缺口；差距 a space between two objects or two parts of an object, especially because something is missing

es.e: a gap in the traffic
es.c: 车流中的一个空档

es.e: the widening gap between the rich and the poor
es.c: 越来越大的贫富差距

es.e: ...you have to be aware of a gap in your knowledge in the first place...

d: adj 有关的，切题的 directly relating to the subject or problem being discussed or considered

es.e: Relevant documents were presented in court.
es.c: 法庭上出示了相关的文件。

es.e: We received all the relevant information.
es.c: 我们收到了所有相关信息。

es.e: ...This process improves access to relevant information...

d: v 忽视，不顾 to behave as if you had not heard or seen someone or something

es.e: The phone rang, but she ignored it.
es.c: 电话铃响了，但她只当没听见。

es.e: Sam rudely ignored the question.
es.c: 萨姆粗鲁地对这个问题不予理睬。

es.e: ...then it would react to the irregular beeps by stirring people from sleep and would ignore the regularly timed ones...

d: v 完成 to finish doing or making something, especially when it has taken a long time；adj 完整的，彻底的 used to emphasize that a quality or situation is as great as it could possibly be

es.e: Students must complete the course.
es.c: 学生必须学完这门课程。

es.e: The building took two years to complete.
es.c: 这幢大楼花了两年时间才完工。

es.e: The darkness was almost complete.
es.c: 几乎是漆黑一片。

d: adj 足够的 as much as is needed for a particular purpose

es.e: We can only prosecute if there is sufficient evidence.
es.c: 有了足够的证据，我们才能提出起诉。

es.e: Unauthorized absence is sufficient reason for dismissal.
es.c: 旷工足以成为解雇的理由。

es.e: We need sufficient time to deal with the problem.
es.c: 我们需要足够的时间来处理这个问题。

d: v 转变，改变 to change from doing or using one thing to doing or using another

es.e: The terrorists will switch tactics .
es.c: 恐怖分子会改变战术。

es.e: ...and so he did not switch to the manual mode...
...Leah shed the safety of her accounting job and made the switch complete...

d: n 要求 a polite or formal demand for something

es.e: France had agreed to his request for political asylum.
es.c: 法国已经同意了他政治避难的请求。

es.e: ...Women want to be able todo it all volunteer for school parties or cook delicious meals-and so their answer to any request is often ―Yes...
...But anyway I'll send him an email to request a meeting...

d: n 老套，固定模式 a belief or idea of what a particular type of person or thing is like. Stereotypes are often unfair or untrue.

es.e: There's always been a stereotype about successful businessmen.
es.c: 对成功的商人们总有一种成见。

es.e: ...Single-sex education also made it less likely that boys would feel they had to conform to a stereotype that men should be "masterful and in charge" in relationships...
...black women still can’t escape the stereotype of being eye-rolling...

d: n 夫妻，情侣 two people who are married or having a sexual or romantic relationship

es.e: a newly married couple
es.c: 一对新婚夫妇

es.e: the couple next door
es.c: 隔壁的那对夫妇

es.e: ...A couple of recent papers have finally opened a window on these people’s extraordinary minds...

d: n 诚实 the quality of being honest

es.e: a politician of rare honesty and courage
es.c: 具备少见的诚实及勇气的政治家

es.e: ...We must rely on the honesty and good faith of others...

d: n 运输 a system or method for carrying passengers or goods from one place to another

es.e: The city needs to improve its public transportation (= buses, trains etc ) .
es.c: 这座城市需要改善公共交通。

es.e: ...Good transportation is very important in winter...

d: adj 身体上的 related to someone’s body rather than their mind or emotions

es.e: She was in constant physical pain.
es.c: 她一直感到身上疼痛。

es.e: the physical and emotional needs of young adults
es.c: 青年人的身心需求

es.e: people with severe physical disabilities
es.c: 身体重度残疾的人

d: v 筛查 to do tests on a lot of people to find out whether they have a particular illness

es.e: All women over 50 will be regularly screened.
es.c: 所有50岁以上女性都将定期接受检查。

es.e: ...Facial photos of dogs and humans were displayed on the screen for 1...
...We have a rule of no screen time during the week...

d: adj 神圣的 coming from or relating to God or a god

es.e: divine power
es.c: 神的力量

es.e: divine love
es.c: 上帝的慈爱

d: n 指导原则 rules or instructions about the best way to do something

es.e: This chapter gives you some guidelines to help you in your work.
es.c: 本章将介绍一些指导性原则，为你的工作提供帮助。

d: n 革命 a complete change in ways of thinking, methods of working etc

es.e: the French Revolution of 1789
es.c: 1789年法国大革命

es.e: ...connected with Chinese revolution and the Communist party...
...The authors do an excellent job of examining the implications of the Internet revolution for individuals...

d: n 打扰；中断 something that temporarily stops an activity or a situation; a time when an activity is stopped

es.e: He ignored her interruptions.
es.c: 他没有理会她的打岔。

es.e: The birth of her son was a minor interruption to her career.
es.c: 她儿子的出生对她的事业造成一个小小的中断。

d: n 洗碗机 a machine that washes dishes

es.e: Finally, rinse the cutting board again with hot water or toss it in the dishwasher.
es.c: 最后，再次用热水冲洗切菜板，或者将它放入洗碗机里清洗。

d: adj 有希望的，有前途的 showing signs of being successful or good in the future

es.e: a promising career in law
es.c: 很有前途的法律职业

es.e: a promising young actor
es.c: 大有前途的年轻演员

es.e: a promising start
es.c: 良好的开端

d: v 不同；变化 if several things of the same type vary, they are all different from each other

es.e: Test scores vary from school to school.
es.c: 测验成绩各校不同。

es.e: The heights of the plants vary from 8 cm to 20 cm.
es.c: 这些植物的高度从8厘米到20厘米不等。

es.e: Medical treatment varies greatly from state to state.
es.c: 医疗制度州与州之间差异很大。

d: adj 永久的 continuing to exist for a long time or for all the time in the future

es.e: He gave up a permanent job in order to freelance.
es.c: 他放弃了固定工作，为的是当一名自由职业者。

es.e: a permanent change in your eating habits
es.c: 饮食习惯的永久改变

es.e: The blindness that the disease causes will be permanent.
es.c: 这种疾病引起的失明是永久性的。

d: v 制造，生产 to use machines to make goods or materials, usually in large numbers or amounts

es.e: the company that manufactured the drug
es.c: 生产这种药的公司

es.e: manufactured goods
es.c: 工业品，制成品

d: adj 爱挑剔的； very concerned about small, usually unimportant details, and difficult to please

es.e: A lot of small children are fussy eaters (= they dislike many types of food ) .
es.c: 许多小孩子挑食。

d: v 命令，规定 to tell someone exactly what they must do or how they must behave；n 命令，规定 an order, rule, or principle that you have to obey

es.e: Federal funds have to be used as dictated by Washington.
es.c: 联邦款项得按照华盛顿规定的途径使用。

es.e: The US government attempted to dictate the terms of the agreement.
es.c: 美国政府企图规定协议的条款。

es.e: teenagers following the dictates of fashion
es.c: 赶时髦的青少年

d: adj 专业的 showing that someone has been well trained and is good at their work

es.e: This business plan looks very professional.
es.c: 这个商业计划看上去很有专业水平。

es.e: a more professional approach to work
es.c: 更专业的工作方法

es.e: ...he has since become a professional painter...

d: v 繁荣 if people or businesses prosper, they grow and develop in a successful way, especially by becoming rich or making a large profit

es.e: Businesses across the state are prospering.
es.c: 整个州的企业都很景气。

d: n 交换，交流 the act of giving someone something and receiving something else from them；v 交换，交流 to give someone something and receive the same kind of thing from them at the same time

es.e: Four of my cassettes for your Madonna CD is a fair exchange.
es.c: 我用四盒磁带换你的麦当娜激光唱片很公平。

es.e: We exchange gifts at Christmas.
es.c: 我们在圣诞节时交换礼物。

es.e: ...And while Europeans don’t generally exchange business gifts...

d: n 集中 a large amount of something in a particular place or among particular people

es.e: The area has one of the world's greatest concentrations of wildlife.
es.c: 该地区有世界上野生生物最集中的区域之一。

d: n 手势，姿势 a movement of part of your body, especially your hands or head, to show what you mean or how you feel

es.e: 萨拉用拳头做了个威胁的手势。
es.c: Sarah made a menacing gesture with her fist.

es.e: ...but for them the gesture means goodbye or go away...
...Speakers of English have a similar gesture though the hand may not be cupped and the fingers may be held more loosely...

d: adj 故意的 intended or planned

es.e: a deliberate attempt to humiliate her
es.c: 对她的故意羞辱

es.e: The attack on him was quite deliberate.
es.c: 对他的袭击完全是有预谋的。

d: n 贡献；捐款 something that you give or do in order to help something be successful

es.e: Einstein was awarded the Nobel Prize for his contribution to Quantum Theory.
es.c: 爱因斯坦因对量子论的贡献而获授诺贝尔奖。

es.e: a campaign contribution
es.c: 竞选捐款

es.e: ...cultural and economic contribution to the UK...

d: v 保佑，祝福 if God blesses someone or something, he helps and protects them

es.e: May God bless you.
es.c: 愿上帝保佑你。

d: n 侦探 a police officer whose job is to discover information about crimes and catch criminals

es.e: She hired a detective to find out if her husband was having an affair.
es.c: 她雇了一个私人侦探调查她丈夫是否有外遇。

es.e: ...Mysteries and detective stories came second on the list at 53%...

d: adj 明显的 easy to see, notice, or understand

es.e: Bob ate his lunch with evident enjoyment.
es.c: 显然鲍勃吃午饭吃得津津有味。

d: v 退避，后退；撤退 to move away from someone or something

es.e: He saw her and retreated, too shy to speak to her.
es.c: 他看到她就躲开了，不好意思跟她讲话。

es.e: They were attacked and forced to retreat.
es.c: 他们受到攻击，被迫撤退。

d: adj 负责的，有责任的 if someone is responsible for an accident, mistake, crime etc, it is their fault or they can be blamed

es.e: We are determined to bring the people responsible to justice.
es.c: 我们决意要将肇事者绳之以法。

es.e: ...when the most recent oil price shock has been partly responsible for kicking off the great recession...
...If we are all to be responsible for one another's health insurance...

d: n 身份 someone’s identity is their name or who they are

es.e: The identity of the killer is still unknown.
es.c: 凶手的身份仍未查明。

es.e: ...Your identity has been formed; you’ve built up your resources; and now you have the chance to take the big risks precisely because your foundation is already secure...

d: n 统计学；数据 quantitative data on any subject, esp data comparing the distribution of some quantity for different subclasses of the population

es.e: Statistics suggest that the population of this country will be double in ten years' time.
es.c: 统计显示，这个国家人口在10年内将增加一倍。

es.e: ...Beall said: Government statistics for the first time provide real evidence that the changes to UK visa regulations may have discouraged many students from applying to the UK...
...The United States Department of Agriculture and the food industry collect sales statistics and keep accurate records...

d: v 感激；欣赏 used to thank someone in a polite way or to say that you are grateful for something they have done

es.e: Thanks ever so much for your help, I really appreciate it.
es.c: 多谢你的帮助，我真的很感激。

es.e: I appreciate your concern , but honestly, I’m fine.
es.c: 谢谢你关心，不过说真的，我很好。

es.e: I’d appreciate it if you let me get on with my job.
es.c: 如果你能让我继续工作，我会非常感激。

d: v 侮辱 to offend someone by saying or doing something they think is rude

es.e: Nobody insults my family and gets away with it!
es.c: 谁也别想侮辱了我的家人之后就这么算了！

es.e: I hope Andy won’t be insulted if I don’t come.
es.c: 如果我不来，希望安迪不要介意。

es.e: ...I'llcall the police if you dare insult me...

d: v 疏忽；忽视 to fail to look after someone or something properly

es.e: She smoked and drank, neglected the children, and left the clothes unmended.
es.c: 她抽烟喝酒，既不照顾孩子，也不缝补衣服。

es.e: The building has been badly neglected.
es.c: 这栋大楼严重疏于维护。

es.e: Many of these ideas have been neglected by modern historians.
es.c: 这些观点有许多都被现代的历史学家忽略了。

d: adv 主要地，首先 mainly

es.e: The advertisement is aimed primarily at children.
es.c: 这则广告的对象主要是儿童。

es.e: ...And why not limit sale of food in places that aren't primarily food stores...
...The common prescription is to primarily shop the grocery store...

d: v 渴望 to want something very much, especially when it seems unlikely to happen soon

es.e: He longed to see her again.
es.c: 到那里去要多长时间？

es.e: She longed for the chance to speak to him in private.
es.c: 她渴望有机会和他私下交谈。

es.e: ...and could wear their hair long too...

d: v 倾向于 if a situation, fact etc inclines you to do or think something, it influences you towards a particular action or opinion

es.e: ...the factors that incline us toward particular beliefs.
es.c: …使我们倾向于特定信念的种种因素。

d: n 有价值的人(或物)资产 the things that a company owns, that can be sold to pay debts

es.e: the value of a company’s assets
es.c: 公司的资产价值

d: v 超车 to go past a moving vehicle or person because you are going faster than them and want to get in front of them

es.e: He pulled out to overtake the van.
es.c: 他把车驶出所在车道想超过那辆小货车。

es.e: Never try to overtake on a bend.
es.c: 绝不要在转弯处超车。

es.e: ...China could overtake the United States as the world's largest express market...

d: n 分机 one of many telephone lines connected to a central system in a large building, which all have different numbers

es.e: Can I have extension 316, please?
es.c: 能帮我接316号分机吗？

es.e: ...We see our children as an extension of ourselves...

d: n 引擎，发动机 the part of a vehicle that produces power to make it move

es.e: Is the engine running smoothly?
es.c: 发动机运转平稳吗？

es.e: We were stranded with engine trouble on a deserted highway.
es.c: 我们因发动机故障而被困在空无一人的公路上。

es.e: ...he quotes Google co-founder Larry Page to the effect that "the perfect search engine" will "understand exactly what i mean and give me back exactly what i want" elsewhere in the book...

d: v 强调 to say something in a strong way

es.e: The report emphasizes the importance of improving safety standards.
es.c: 报告强调了改进安全标准的重要性。

es.e: Logan made a speech emphasizing the need for more volunteers.
es.c: 罗根发表演讲，强调需要更多的志愿者。

es.e: ...What did Alex want to emphasize at the end of his presentation...

d: adj 真正的 a genuine feeling, desire etc is one that you really feel, not one you pretend to feel

es.e: ‘Did he really?’ Her surprise seemed genuine.
es.c: “他真的这样？”她好像是真的惊讶。

es.e: ...Theintimate nature of genuine criticism implies something about who is able to give it...
...Sometimes people cannot cry despite genuine grief...

d: n 魅力；入迷 something that interests you very much, or the quality of being very interesting

es.e: The fascination lay in the mystery of what was inside the box.
es.c: 吸引力就在于这神秘感——不知道盒子里是什么东西。

d: v 住宿，暂住 to pay to live in a room in someone’s house

es.e: John lodged with a family in Bristol when he first started work.
es.c: 约翰刚开始工作时寄住在布里斯托尔的一户人家家里。

d: v 欺骗, 作弊 to behave in a dishonest way in order to win or to get an advantage, especially in a competition, game, or examination

es.e: He had cheated in the test by using a calculator.
es.c: 他在考试时作弊，用了计算器。

es.e: Don’t look at my cards - that’s cheating .
es.c: 别看我的牌，那是作弊。

es.e: ...It may seem that these elderly people are trying to cheat death...

d: n 安全，安保 things that are done to keep a person, building, or country safe from danger or crime

es.e: The trial was held under tight security .
es.c: 这场审讯是在戒备森严的情况下进行的。

es.e: lax security at airline check-in desks
es.c: 登机手续柜台松懈的安全措施

es.e: terrorist activity that is a threat to national security
es.c: 威胁国家安全的恐怖活动

d: adj 痛苦的，疼痛的，令人不快的 if a part of your body is painful, it hurts

es.e: stiff painful joints
es.c: 僵硬疼痛的关节

es.e: Is your arm very painful?
es.c: 你的手臂很疼吗？

es.e: The neck becomes swollen and painful to the touch (= hurts when you touch it ) .
es.c: 脖子肿起来了，一碰就疼。

d: v 出现 to appear or come out from somewhere

es.e: The flowers emerge in the spring.
es.c: 花儿在春天开放。

es.e: ...but the survivors will emerge leaner and stronger than before...

d: n 情况，例子 an example of a particular kind of situation

es.e: In this instance I think she was mistaken.
es.c: 在这一点上我认为她弄错了。

es.e: ...who protest that government regulation would be yet another instance of interference in our lives...

d: adj 陡峭的；急剧升/降的 a road, hill etc that is steep slopes at a high angle

es.e: The road became rocky and steep.
es.c: 路变得崎岖陡峭起来。

es.e: a steep climb to the top
es.c: 到山顶的一段陡坡

es.e: steep cuts in benefits
es.c: 救济金的大幅度削减

d: adj 严格的 careful, thorough, and exact

es.e: a rigorous analysis of defence needs
es.c: 对国防需求的缜密分析

es.e: the rigorous standards required by the college
es.c: 大学规定的严格标准

d: v 说服 to make someone decide to do something, especially by giving them reasons why they should do it, or asking them many times to do it

es.e: He was fairly easily persuaded .
es.c: 他很轻易就被说服了。

d: n 程序 a way of doing something, especially the correct or usual way

es.e: On board, we were given the usual talk on safety procedures (= what to do if an accident happens, or to prevent an accident ) .
es.c: 在飞机上，我们听了例行的飞行安全讲解。

es.e: ...The examination and approval procedure wasn't prudentlyrestored until October...

d: n 签名 your name written in the way you usually write it, for example at the end of a letter, or on a cheque etc, to show that you have written it

es.e: Her signature is totally illegible (= cannot be read ) .
es.c: 她的签字完全无法辨认。

es.e: The school collected 4,000 signatures for the petition.
es.c: 学校为这份请愿书收集到了四千个签名。

es.e: The Ukrainians put their signatures to the Lisbon Protocol.
es.c: 乌克兰签署了《里斯本协议》。

d: v 超过 to be even better or greater than someone or something else

es.e: He had surpassed all our expectations .
es.c: 他超越了我们所有的预期。

es.e: The number of multiple births has surpassed 100,000 for the first time.
es.c: 多胎产首次突破了 10 万例。

es.e: ...Now that women are the majority of college students and surpass men in both the number of undergraduate and advanced degrees awarded...

d: n 活动 a series of actions intended to achieve a particular result relating to politics or business, or a social improvement

es.e: Jones ran a good campaign.
es.c: 琼斯的活动搞得很成功。

es.e: Police have launched a campaign to crack down on drug dealers.
es.c: 警方发起了一场严厉打击毒贩的运动。

es.e: ...We went on a campaign trip once in Italy...

d: n 提前 before something happens or is expected to happen；v 前进 to move towards someone or something, especially in a slow and determined way – used especially to talk about soldiers
